00054 #define BinaryOpUGenConstructor(INTERNALUGENCLASSNAME, leftOperand_, rightOperand_)          \
00055   if(leftOperand_.getNumChannels() > rightOperand_.getNumChannels())            \
00056    initInternal(leftOperand_.getNumChannels());                \
00057   else                           \
00058    initInternal(rightOperand_.getNumChannels());                \
00059                               \
00060   for(int i = 0; i < numInternalUGens; i++)                  \
00061   {                            \
00062    internalUGens[i] = new INTERNALUGENCLASSNAME(leftOperand_, rightOperand_);         \
00063   }

00066 #define BinaryOpSymbolUGenProcessBlock(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL)       \
00067   const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();              \
00068   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                \
00069   const float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);   \
00070   const float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);   \
00071                               \
00072   for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i) {                 \
00073    outputSamples[i] = leftOperandSamples[i] OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL rightOperandSamples[i];       \
00074   }
00075  
00076 
00077 #define BinaryOpSymbolUGenProcessBlock_K(shouldDelete_, blockID_, channel_, OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL)       \
00078   const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();              \
00079   unsigned int blockPosition = blockID % krBlockSize;                \
00080   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();               \
00081   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                \
00082   float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);     \
00083   float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);    \
00084                               \
00085   int numKrSamples = blockPosition % krBlockSize;                 \
00086                               \
00087    while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                   \
00088     float nextValue = value;                    \
00089     if(numKrSamples == 0)                     \
00090      nextValue = *leftOperandSamples OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightOperandSamples;        \
00091                               \
00092     numKrSamples = krBlockSize - numKrSamples;                \
00093                               \
00094     blockPosition  += numKrSamples;                 \
00095     leftOperandSamples += numKrSamples;                 \
00096     rightOperandSamples += numKrSamples;                 \
00097                               \
00098     if(nextValue == value) {                    \
00099      while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {              \
00100       *outputSamples++ = nextValue;                 \
00101       --numSamplesToProcess;                   \
00102       --numKrSamples;                     \
00103      }                         \
00104     } else {                        \
00105      float valueSlope = (nextValue - value) / (float)UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();     \
00106      while(numSamplesToProcess && numKrSamples) {              \
00107       *outputSamples++ = value;                  \
00108       value += valueSlope;                   \
00109       --numSamplesToProcess;                   \
00110       --numKrSamples;                     \
00111      }                         \
00112      value = nextValue;                     \
00113     }                          \
00114    }                           \
00115

00119   float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();                \
00120   const float* leftOperandSamples = inputs[LeftOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);   \
00121   const float* rightOperandSamples = inputs[RightOperand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID_, channel_);   \
00122                               \
00123   for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i) {                 \

00129   const int krBlockSize = UGen::getControlRateBlockSize();              \

00136   int numKrSamples = blockPosition & krBlockSize;                 \
00137                               \
00138    while(numSamplesToProcess > 0) {                   \
00139     float nextValue = value;                    \
00140     if(numKrSamples == 0)                     \
00141      nextValue = OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*leftOperandSamples, *rightOperandSamples);       \
00142                               \

00144                               \
00145     blockPosition  += numKrSamples;                 \

00395  Buffer Buffer::operator OPSYMBOL (Buffer const& rightOperand) const throw()           \
00396  {                             \
00397   const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; \
00398   const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;         \
00399   const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;         \
00400   const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                   \
00401                               \
00402   Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));             \
00403                               \
00404   for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)          \
00405   {                            \
00406    int numSamples;                        \
00407    float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;           \
00408    float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;    \
00409    float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;            \
00410                               \
00411    if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                  \
00412     numSamples = maxSize;                     \
00413                               \
00414     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                    \
00415      *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;         \
00416     }                          \
00417    } else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) {          \
00418     numSamples = maxSize;                     \
00419                               \
00420     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                    \
00421      *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples;         \
00422     }                          \
00423    } else {                         \
00424     numSamples = minSize;                     \
00425     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                    \
00426      *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;        \
00427     }                          \
00428                               \
00429     numSamples = diffSize;                     \
00430     if(size_ > rightOperand.size_) {                  \
00431      while(--numSamples >= 0) {                   \
00432       *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL 0.f;          \
00433      }                         \
00434     }                          \
00435     else if(rightOperand.size_ > size_) {                 \
00436      while(--numSamples >= 0) {                   \
00437       *outputSamples++ = 0.f OPSYMBOL_INTERNAL *rightSamples++;          \
00438      }                         \
00439     }                          \
00440    }                           \
00441   }                            \
00442                               \
00443   return newBuffer;                        \
00444  }                             \

00547  Buffer Buffer::OPFUNCTION (Buffer const& rightOperand) const throw()            \
00548  {                             \
00549   const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; \
00550   const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;         \
00551   const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;         \
00552   const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                   \
00553                               \
00554   Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));             \
00555                               \
00556   for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)          \
00557   {                            \
00558    int numSamples;                        \
00559    float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;           \
00560    float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;    \
00561    float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;            \
00562                               \
00563    if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                  \
00564     numSamples = maxSize;                     \
00565                               \
00566     while(--numSamples >= 0) {                    \
00567      *outputSamples++ = ugen::OPFUNCTION_INTERNAL(*leftSamples, *rightSamples++);      \
00568     }                          \
00569    } else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) {          \
00570     numSamples = maxSize;                     \
